title: [Staging][Customer] Transfer above 10,000 EGP succeeds without an error message
preconditions: Customer is logged in, and the balance is 20,000 EGP
expected:
EN: "Amount exceeds the maximum limit"
AR: "المبلغ أكبر من الحد الأقصى المسموح"
No transfer is made.
actual: No message appears. The transfer is completed, and the balance becomes 9,999 EGP.
